items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: we did one with three baritones, Cecil Payne and Ronnie Cuber... I just did one three months ago with three baritones — Ronnie Cuber, Gary Smulyan and myself

ctx.x: Well you’ve been able to get together with some of your contemporaries on the baritone on some of your records, right?

Oh, yeah. I recorded a duo, the first time I ever did it was with Pepper Adams and then we did one with three baritones, Cecil Payne and Ronnie Cuber. And I just did one three months ago with three baritones — Ronnie Cuber, Gary Smulyan and myself, and we did the music of Gerry Mulligan. And we took all Mulligan tunes. And maybe Gerry would roll over in his grave if he heard us playing it, but it was some interesting things. You know, with three different guys playing Mulligan’s music, of all the musics. But one…
